environment.description: Same application deployed behind an nginx reverse proxy (v1.25.3) with a location block that appends response headers via add_header directive. The nginx configuration includes a default snippet inherited from the infrastructure team's base template at /etc/nginx/conf.d/security-baseline.conf which sets a Content-Security-Policy header. However, the policy uses 'self' for default-src but notably includes 'unsafe-eval' in script-src to support a legacy analytics library (Matomo/Piwik JS tracker) that the ops team hasn't migrated off yet. The full directive reads: add_header Content-Security-Policy "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-eval' https://analytics.internal.corp; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'" always; — Note that 'unsafe-inline' is NOT present in script-src, only in style-src. The 'always' parameter ensures the header is sent even on error responses. The nginx proxy_pass forwards to localhost:3000.

config.csp_header: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-eval' https://analytics.internal.corp; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'
config.notes: unsafe-eval in script-src required for Matomo legacy tracker; ops ticket INFRA-4421 open to migrate
